title: Wringer build spec
description: `wringer.spec.yaml` — what `wring spec` drafts from a PRD and a human approves before anything runs. Source, not evidence: it is committed, and the human edits it. `wring plan` re-reads it from disk every time.

approved.description: THE INTERLOCK. `wring plan` refuses while this is false. Always drafted false; only a person editing the file may make it true — no flag, no environment variable, and no model reply can. Required rather than defaulted, so a spec that forgot to say is not approved by omission.

intent.description: The human's own words, quoted verbatim from the PRD by Wringer — never the model's paraphrase of them. The reader checks the criteria against this.

open_questions.description: What the drafter had to assume, asked instead of guessed. `wring plan` refuses while a `required` one is unanswered. At most 20.

answer.description: Written by the human. A question is answered when this is non-empty; deleting the question works too. Both are file edits, which is the only kind of approval this slice accepts.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria, which are a `wringer.rubric.v1` criteria list by construction — `wring plan` writes them to wringer.rubric.yaml unmodified and the judge consumes them with no translation layer. Inlined rather than $ref'd so this file resolves without a network fetch; tests/test_schema.py fails if the two definitions ever differ.

id.description: A slug: it is matched against the ids in a model's reply, so it must be unambiguous.

guidance.description: How to decide it. Optional; absent and empty mean the same thing.

required.description: Defaults to true. An unmet required criterion is a `fail` verdict.

human.description: Defaults to false. When true the criterion is never sent to a judge and comes back unscored: only a person can decide it, and a model asked anyway would be guessing.

gates.description: Gates the drafter proposes. `wring plan` prints these as a diff against .wringer.yaml and stops — Wringer never installs a gate, because installing one changes what 'verified' means. Same shape and same parser as a .wringer.yaml gate.

required.description: Accepted as the negation of `optional`; both together is an error.

tasks.description: The build plan. `wring plan` turns each into a line of tasks.jsonl and writes its brief to the path named here. At most 50: a single drafting pass proposing more than that did not understand the PRD.

id.description: A slug: it becomes a fleet task id, which names a directory.

brief.description: Where `wring plan` writes this task's brief. Relative to the repository root and refused if it could escape it — this path is written to, and a model proposed it.

dir.description: Which directory the task runs in. Defaults to '.', relative to the repository root, and must exist.

objective.description: One paragraph saying what done looks like. Becomes the body of the brief.
